captions.text: A ghost hand teaches the first shape. Copy it, and the shadow wakes.
Then the Lantern tells a story nobody has heard before, told live by Claude.
You answer with your hands: the shadow you make is who comes next.
Make someone else, and the story bends around your surprise.
The stage follows the story: snow, rain, thunder, moonrise, dawn.
Every tale goes into your Book of Shadows. Tomorrow, a new one.
